rules: Use either route, or to with optional from.
from defaults to current when to is used.
route must reference the stable route catalog.
to/from entity references must exist in the entity registry.
label may be explicit in copy; otherwise use a localized deterministic fallback.
href always contains lang, ref=seo_landing and campaign=<pageId>.

selectionOrder: nearby curated place landing as fallback

related_reading.routeStrategy: rank origin and destination entities, merge by URL, deduplicate, add a small both-endpoints relevance bonus

rules: group must exist in the tourist fare registry.
Only visitor-facing fares may be rendered.
Each item exposes priceType, lastVerified and sourceUrl.
Indicative third-party fares must be visibly labelled as indicative.
The renderer must show a verification date and avoid implying a guaranteed fare.
